title: RESILIO : A Scalable and Composable Architecture for Tomographic Reconstruction Workflows
problem: Tomographic reconstruction pipelines struggle with high-volume data, low latency requirements, fault tolerance, and scalability in scientific facilities.
motivation: Advanced synchrotrons (e.g., upgraded APS) enable unprecedented data rates, but traditional batch workflows cannot keep up.
method: RESILIO: composable, high-performance framework built on Mochi ecosystem using Mofka for persistent streaming and resilience.
key_novelty: High-performance composable architecture for tomographic reconstruction with streaming resilience
contributions: 3490x reduction in per-event overhead vs ZeroMQ
limitations: Limited details on specific system configurations; applicability to other streaming workflows unclear.
